info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Treasury By Param1-spec
info.description: The Treasury Securities Financing Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about treasury securities based on specific parameters. This endpoint provides relevant financial data that is essential for financial analysts, treasury managers, and investment professionals. It enables stakeholders to evaluate securities financing options and make informed decisions. Typical use cases include retrieving data for compliance reporting, risk assessment, and investment strategy formulation.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves detailed information about a specific securities financing transaction identified by its unique ID. It provides access to critical data relevant to finance and investment stakeholders.
